case.summary: The cardholder C13171 reported an unauthorized $55.68 online purchase made from a proxy desktop device. The same card and device have been involved in multiple prior confirmed card‑not‑present fraud cases (AGENT-HHG-008, CC-5010, CC-4485, CC-0056). Combined with the customer denial and the proxy device, the fraud probability is high (0.92). The case is closed as fraud with the card blocked and a SAR filed.
